tool_args.rationale: The observations show a baseline matching x_now when u_now equals u_past and a signed step contribution that diminishes with horizon. Fit the two temporal parameters (step amplitude and decay rate) to all eight paid rows; the opposing step directions and expanded horizon range provide identification.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid trajectory batch now spans horizons 0.25–1.35 and both step directions, enough to fit and distinguish a decaying step response.
A simple Maxwell response omits the observed x_now baseline; the proposed model captures baseline plus horizon-decaying before/after step contribution.
The target varies strongly with the signed input difference, which an OU snapshot drift does not explain.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the temporal response.
